acceptance: Protocol and API evidence is typed, authorized and provenance-tagged with shapes and templates only; undocumented traffic starts unsupported and can only be promoted with documentation and a reviewed witness.

positive.fixture: 7 tests: 5 valid fixtures pass the schema and rules; the JSON Schema and the hand-written checks agree

negative.fixture: 20 invalid fixtures each rejected with exactly the expected reason, including unpromoted traffic, sample values, credentials in URLs and concrete identifiers

security_and_source_permissions: The observer reads structure and declared labels only; form values are never read, credential regions yield no text, account text is flagged and withheld from shared evidence, and no network surface exists.
performance_memory_storage: Validation is linear in document size.
known_limitations: Not yet an IR family; adding one is an additive IR minor left to the first consumer
